# GLAD

The files in this directory were generated by GLAD 2.0.0-beta for OpenGL 3.3 and copied from the
GLFW dependency sources already vendored by Pico:

```text
ThirdParty/GLFW/deps/glad/gl.h
ThirdParty/GLFW/deps/glad/khrplatform.h
ThirdParty/GLFW/deps/glad_gl.c
```

Generation options are recorded at the top of `include/glad/gl.h`. The generated code may be used
under Public Domain, WTFPL, or CC0 terms as described by the GLAD project.
